display_name: 双骨干互补证据：冻结16模型立即全量测试
description: 用户在GPU每卡4训练满载后要求直接启动；每卡临时增加1推理，总<=5，保留健康训练与冻结测试矩阵。
authorization: 2026-10-09 用户在获知8卡每卡4进程占满、测试排队后指令：直接启动。仅测试调度临时覆盖，训练不动。

data.representation: equalized=1; center256; unit packet RMS; fs=25000000Hz
data.tx_sets_ref: ManySig.tx_list: all6; actual physical class strings exported at runtime

roles.U_use: Own EMA old batch-neighbor pseudo CE and full-U entropy from E131

data.leo_config_ref: Native practical3 supervised concat; unchanged cvs_phase1_repair pseudo_batch_cosine

permissions.query_use: Frozen per-packet Phase1 inference only; separate truth-last scorer
permissions.claim_scope: Previously exposed clean and six full practical residual proxy views. No blind benchmark or formal satellite/Phase2 claim.

checkpoint.selection_rule: All16 original fixed controls; inherit original pre-query source freeze

execution.gpu_policy: User immediate-test override: at most1 extra inference/GPU; total<=5 including CUDA/pre-CUDA; free>=3000MiB; preserve all training
execution.stop_rule: Only affected technical failure; retain artifacts, no automatic retry, fallback or low-performance stop. No interventions on healthy existing jobs.

metrics_plan.scorer_ref: experiments/cvs_dual_evidence/evaluate.py score; separate process after all112 predictions; independent confusion/F1 recount
metrics_plan.primary: Four model seeds mean/sample SD and paired deltas; accuracy/F1/worst RX; six-view mean paired effects; all negative results retained
metrics_plan.desired_gain: six-view mean >=+2pp; clean drop<=.5pp; no systematic worstRX decline; >=3/4seed same direction. Scientific aim, not stop or tuning gate.
metrics_plan.resource_limits: Shared-GPU wall time and per-process CUDA peak; no isolated speed claim. Source RSS/FLOPs N/A. Phase2 K/adaptation/new TX/H/transfer N/A.

notes: Old batch_neighbor gating, own EMA .999, U CE .16 and fullU entropy .01 E131+, confidence .86 quantile clipped .92-.97, no domain gate. CosineLR is not cosine classifier.
No old weights/teacher/optimizer inherited; no GRL, orthogonality, MixStyle or new auxiliary loss. Same native concat and backboneA, all44400updates.
Last three arms have identical parameter counts; raw input control, multi-lag curvature and conditional fusion isolate fixed architectural contrasts.
Zero output fusion preserves initial logits. New modules preserve CPU/CUDA RNG. Whole-run stochastic equality across different graphs is not claimed.
Own teacher predictions can change with architecture; log pseudo gates and E130/E200 source metrics. No fixed-pseudo-label representation-only claim.
Previous CE-only residual experiments10000updates cannot establish architectural gains against this semi-supervised44400update matrix.
Source preference descriptive only, all fixed16 controls frozen before any query, all112 predictions before truth. No target feedback or selective retraining.
Curve invariance limited to ideal global complex gain/phase/constant CFO in evidence input. No arbitrary channel cancellation or transmitter-factor identifiability claim.
Design and literature: experiments/cvs_dual_evidence/DESIGN.md. Actual clean/6view gains unknown until scoring.

constraints: Evaluation only: per GPU max1 extra inference; all CUDA/pre-CUDA experiment owners total<=5; free>=3000MiB. Original idle controller takeover only after exact PID/start/cwd/argv/no-child/no-prediction checks.
